hero.headline: Practical technology. Meaningful solutions.
hero.text: From digital development and artificial intelligence to technology education and innovation, Edunotech works with individuals and organisations to turn ideas and opportunities into practical outcomes.

services.title: AI and Intelligent Solutions
services.cardText: Helping individuals and organisations explore, understand, and apply artificial intelligence to practical tasks, workflows, and emerging opportunities.
services.short: Helping individuals and organisations understand and apply artificial intelligence to improve the way they learn, work, and solve problems.
detail: Artificial intelligence is creating new possibilities across education, business, research, communication, and everyday operations.
At Edunotech, we explore practical ways to apply AI to real needs. Our focus includes AI education, adoption, workflow improvement, and the development of useful AI-enabled solutions.
services.idealClients: Educational institutions, businesses, organisations, professionals, and other groups seeking to understand or apply AI.

services.title: Web Development and Digital Solutions
services.cardText: Developing websites and digital solutions that help businesses, educational institutions, and organisations strengthen their digital presence and operations.
services.short: Building useful digital platforms and web experiences that help organisations establish their presence, communicate effectively, and serve their audiences.
detail: A strong digital presence is increasingly important for organisations that want to communicate their value, reach their audiences, and make information and services more accessible.
Edunotech develops websites and digital solutions with attention to usability, structure, visual presentation, and the needs of the organisation.
items: Website maintenance and content updates, subject to agreed service arrangements
services.idealClients: Schools, businesses, startups, educational organisations, and institutions.

services.title: Education and Capacity Development
services.cardText: Creating learning experiences that equip people with relevant technology knowledge, digital skills, and practical problem-solving capabilities.
services.short: Developing practical learning experiences that equip people with technology knowledge, digital capabilities, and the ability to solve problems.
detail: Technology education should go beyond theoretical explanations. People need opportunities to understand how technologies work, explore their applications, and develop the confidence to use them.
Edunotech develops educational experiences and training opportunities that connect learning with practical application.
items: AI literacy and practical AI training
Introduction to coding and software development
Technology education for schools and institutions

services.title: Digital Communication and Brand Support
services.cardText: Supporting organisations with digital communication, content, social media management, and relevant brand-support services.
services.short: Helping organisations strengthen their digital communication and present their brands more effectively.
detail: An organisation's ability to communicate clearly and consistently influences how people understand and engage with it.
Edunotech supports organisations with digital communication and brand-related services that help them maintain a more effective presence.
services.note: Specific deliverables, timelines, and pricing are agreed with each client.

services.title: Education Management and Data Solutions
services.cardText: Exploring and providing digital solutions that support educational administration, information management, and institutional processes.
services.short: Exploring digital solutions that help educational institutions organise information and improve administrative processes.
detail: Educational institutions manage information relating to students, academic activities, administration, and institutional operations.
Digital tools can help make these processes more organised, accessible, and efficient.
Edunotech's education-management focus includes digital data-management solutions and related institutional technology.

services.title: Innovation and Product Development
services.cardText: Exploring practical technology opportunities and developing solutions that respond to emerging needs.
services.short: Exploring emerging opportunities and developing technology-driven products that respond to real needs.
detail: Edunotech is interested in identifying gaps, understanding user needs, and exploring how technology can create useful products and services.
This includes exploring applications of artificial intelligence, digital platforms, and other emerging technologies.
Our approach begins with understanding the problem and the people affected before determining the most appropriate technology or solution.

steps.title: Tell Us What You Need
steps.text: Share your organisation, challenge, project, or service requirement.

steps.title: Initial Discussion
steps.text: We discuss the context, expectations, and possible approach.

steps.title: Proposed Scope
steps.text: We identify the relevant service, deliverables, timeline, and commercial terms.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: Work begins based on the agreed scope and arrangement.

steps.title: Review
steps.text: We review the outcome and identify any required improvements or next steps.

cta.heading: Have a project in mind?
cta.text: Let's discuss your needs and explore how the right technology, expertise, and approach can help you move forward.
